topArticle.title: France suspends use of stun grenades against protesters
topArticle.description: France is suspending the use of stun grenades against protesters as allegations of student brutality draw more anger. French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu is scheduled to address protesters later today.

topArticle.title: Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash plane into Tel Aviv airport or building, reports say

topArticle.title: MEPs urge tougher action against China as tensions hit ‘critical point’

topArticle.title: Tigray rebel groups ‘forcibly recruiting boys as young as 15’ as fighting spreads
topArticle.description:
Civilians try to flee as men and boys rounded up on streets by new alliance as Ethiopia conflict erupts again
As renewed fighting has threatened a fresh humanitarian crisis in the northern region of Ethiopia, reports are emerging that a new alliance of armed groups in Tigray has been forcibly recruiting men and boys to its ranks.
Renewed conflict erupted on 23 September between Ethiopia’s federal government and the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF), which rules the region, shattering the fragile Pretoria peace agreement signed between the two sides in November 2022.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: ティグレの反政府勢力が「15歳にも満たない少年を強制徴募」紛争拡大で
topArticle.summary: エチオピアのティグレ地域で戦闘が再燃し、新たな武装勢力連合が少年を含む男性を強制徴募していると報じられた。昨年締結された和平合意が破られ、新たな人道危機が懸念されている。

topArticle.title: Guardian readers fund life-changing surgery for Somali boy injured in US airstrike
topArticle.description:
After Guardian investigation uncovered drone strike that killed 12 civilians and injured many more, seven-year-old Abdiqadir Salah underwent vital operation in Mogadishu
On the rickshaw ride to the hospital, Marian Haji Abdi Guled felt a mixture of joy and apprehension: the day they had been waiting for had finally arrived.
Almost a year earlier, her then seven-year-old son, Abdiqadir Salah, had been seriously injured, alongside his two siblings, in what a Guardian investigation found was a US drone strike on the village of Jamaame in Somalia that killed at least 12 civilians, including eight children.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: ガーディアン読者が米国空爆で負傷したソマリア人少年の人生を変える手術を支援
topArticle.summary: ガーディアンの調査で米国ドローン攻撃の犠牲となったソマリア人少年が、読者の資金援助によりモガディシュで重要な手術を受け、回復への一歩を踏み出した。

topArticle.title: Egyptian journalist faces terrorism charges after entire newsroom detained
topArticle.description:
Calls for release of six Matsadaash staff after one is charged, while whereabouts of other five remain unknown
An Egyptian journalist has been charged with joining a terrorist group, days after an entire newsroom was detained in what rights groups have said is a crackdown on press freedoms.
Last week, authorities arrested six journalists from the independent fact-checking and investigative platform Matsadaash – literally meaning “don’t believe” – accusing them in a statement of being unlicensed and publishing false news on behalf of the outlawed Muslim Brotherhood.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: エジプト人ジャーナリスト、ニュース編集部全員拘束後テロ容疑に直面

topArticle.title: Amid political and economic pressure, Brazil sees a rise in land conflicts and the murders of Indigenous people

topArticle.title: Outcry in Trinidad and Tobago after passing of police bill that could threaten press freedom
topArticle.description:
Journalists call for urgent amendment to special operations bill, which increases police search and seizure powers
Journalists in Trinidad and Tobago have called for an urgent amendment to a sweeping new bill that increases police powers of search and seizure, which they argue threatens the country’s much-vaunted freedom of the press.
The government says the special operations bill 2026, passed on 24 September, is designed to tackle alarmingly high crime and murder rates in the Caribbean nation.
 Continue reading...

topArticle.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
topArticle.titleJa: ペレイラでの「日払い」生活：コロンビア地震の忘れられた生存者たち
topArticle.summary: コロンビアのペレイラで、地震の生存者たちが日払い部屋に住み、今やホームレス、過密シェルター、病気、そして存在を認められるための苦闘に直面している。

topArticle.title: Venezuela’s earthquakes leave children facing trauma, displacement and food insecurity
topArticle.description: As families seek refuge, Venezuela’s youngest children grapple with fear, disrupted routines and the loss of basic nutritional security.
topArticle.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震が子供たちにトラウマ、避難、食料不安をもたらす
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラの地震により、家族が避難所を求める中、幼い子供たちは恐怖、日常の中断、基本的な栄養確保の喪失といった問題に苦しんでいる。

topArticle.title: India's opposition leader dragged on to bus as police break up protest
topArticle.description: Opposition leaders allege that CEC Gyanesh Kumar manipulated voter rolls to favour PM Narendra Modi's party.
topArticle.titleJa: インドの野党指導者、抗議活動解散中に警察によりバスへ連行される
topArticle.summary: インドで野党指導者が警察に抗議活動を解散させられバスに乗せられた。野党は、選挙管理委員が与党を有利にするよう有権者名簿を操作したと主張している。

topArticle.title: Watch: Moment Indonesian shoe shop is torn apart by explosion
topArticle.description: Police have said it is “strongly suspected” that the incident was caused by a gas leak.
topArticle.titleJa: 爆発でインドネシアの靴店が吹き飛ばされる瞬間を捉えた映像
topArticle.summary: インドネシアの靴店が爆発によって破壊される瞬間が映像に収められた。警察はガス漏れが原因であると強く疑っている。

topArticle.title: Samoa leader apologises for Nazi salute after video from 2007 emerges
topArticle.description: Schmidt acknowledged that his actions "were inappropriate and capable of causing offence and hurt".
topArticle.titleJa: サモア指導者、2007年のナチス式敬礼動画流出を受け謝罪
topArticle.summary: サモアの指導者が、2007年からとされるナチス式敬礼をする動画が公開されたことを受け謝罪した。彼は自身の行動が不適切であったと認めている。

topArticle.title: New Zealand advances safe and inclusive trade with new contribution to STDF
topArticle.description: New Zealand has contributed NZ$ 300,000 (approximately CHF 140,000) to the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) to help developing and least-developed countries, including in the Pacific, strengthen food safety and animal and plant health systems.
topArticle.titleJa: ニュージーランド、STDFへの新たな貢献で安全かつ包括的な貿易を推進
topArticle.summary: ニュージーランドは、STDFに30万NZドルの貢献を行い、太平洋諸国を含む開発途上国が食品安全および動植物衛生システムを強化するのを支援する。
